AVIF color math + stubs — references/image/src/codecs/avif/{yuv,ycgco}.rs Full AVIF decode needs an AV1 bitstream decoder (out of scope for pure-Nim v1); decodeAvif/encodeAvif return Unsupported with a clear message. This module ports the reusable color science as scalar reference code: BT.601/709/2020 YCbCr (limited + full range, 8-bit, 444/422/420/400) and lifted YCgCo-Re forward/inverse (used by AV1 lossless paths).
